essence: Beginning a lamp ritual in Rohiṇī is praised.
The lamp ritual is also appropriate in times of affection, joy, good fortune, and for Śobhana and Āyuṣmat.
A lamp beginning done in the forenoon during these conjunctions is auspicious.
The concurrence of Sunday and the Śravaṇa constellation is rare.
On the first day one should fast, remain restrained and celibate, and sleep on the ground.
